finding: Step 1.4 of feature-addition.md runs module-graph-check and reads its result. Since the fix for BUG-0055 the script exits 2 when it cannot read the DSL or the interface contracts. The playbook says nothing about exit 2, so a run that hits it stops with no route forward. The review of story ST-0297 found this. Fix: Add one line to Step 1.4: on exit 2, keep impact.architecture_change as declared and ask the human.
why_this_severity: Step 1.4 names no route for exit 2 of `module-graph-check`, so a run that cannot read the DSL stops without a next step. Exit 0 and exit 1 still route the run, and the agent can ask the human (no to fails_purpose).
